summary: Prompt 2 (FE-only 'Last Edited' popup integration) backend regression + targeted /audit-logs/recent coverage + FE static code review. 17 new pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_last_edited_popup_backend.py (all 17/17 passing) plus prompt-1 regression /app/backend/tests/test_audit_movement_log.py (27/27 passing) = 44/44 total against the live preview URL.

coverage_breakdown.recent_endpoint_contract: no-history → {logs: []}; with N entries returns rows for barcode; limit=1 honored; default limit ≤ 5; results sorted desc by timestamp; 422 when barcode query missing
coverage_breakdown.recent_cross_module: Same barcode with both warehouse + cycle_count reco_adjust entries returns BOTH modules in same /recent response — verified live (3 entries: 2 warehouse + 1 cycle_count)
coverage_breakdown.recent_client_id_filter: client_id=<wh_cid> returns only that client's rows; unknown client_id returns []
coverage_breakdown.existing_endpoints_unchanged: POST /reco-adjustments still returns 200 with non-error payload AND still appends audit_log entry visible via /audit-logs/recent (action_type='reco_adjust', new_value='5'); /audit-logs/search still returns {logs:[], total, limit, skip}
coverage_breakdown.fe_static_review: LastEditedPopup.jsx — (a) fetches /audit-logs/recent ✓ (b) onProceed when logs.length===0 ✓ (c) .catch(...) → onProceed ✓ (d) Dialog only renders when loading|logs.length>0 via shouldShowDialog ✓ (e) module badges blue=warehouse, emerald=cycle_count ✓ (f) data-testids 'last-edited-proceed-btn'/'last-edited-cancel-btn' ✓. useLastEditPopup.js — openPopup/closePopup/popupProps ✓, useRef+onProceedRef ✓, handleProceed clears ref BEFORE invoking cb ✓ (verified char-offset). BarcodeEditCell — 2 LastEditedPopup render sites (editing + display branches), startEdit calls lastEdit.openPopup(_bc, clientId, _openEditor) ✓. PortalReports — exactly 3 RecoInput callsites pass clientId + recoBarcode ✓, openEditor wraps setEditing in lastEdit.openPopup(recoBarcode, clientId, _go) ✓. FullScreenReport RecoCell — lastEdit.openPopup invoked with clientId in scope ✓.
coverage_breakdown.prompt1_regression: All 27 prompt-1 tests still pass: search/recent/export endpoints, cycle-count hooks (close-day/reopen-day/delete-day/complete-project/reopen-project/delete-project), reco_adjust hooks, filter coverage, non-blocking code review, MongoDB indexes.

items_not_directly_tested: POST /reports/edit-barcode happy-path log entry — requires uploading master_products / expected_stock fixtures (validator rejects barcodes not in master). Reviewed via source: log_audit_entry call sites at audit_routes.py for edit/undo are unchanged from prompt 1.

Live UI gating of the LastEditedPopup modal (Radix Dialog visibility, Proceed/Cancel click flow) — review_request explicitly marks frontend as skipped. FE wiring verified via static source assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: LastEditedPopup.jsx useEffect dependency array includes onProceed and onClose — because these come from useLastEditPopup's useCallback they should be stable, but if a future caller passes inline functions the fetch will re-fire on every parent render. Consider stashing them in refs inside the popup too, mirroring the hook's pattern.
LastEditedPopup uses BACKEND_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL captured at module-import time — safe for current build pipeline but worth a comment so nobody tries to flip it at runtime.

The 'no history → silent skip' contract is implemented by mounting the Dialog with open=false (shouldShowDialog gating) AND ALSO firing onProceed inside the .then handler. Both paths converge correctly, but if the parent unmounts while the fetch is in flight, the reqIdRef guard prevents stale onProceed — verified by code review. Good.
audit_routes.py is still 7087 lines (carry-over comment from prompt 1, not introduced by prompt 2).
Suggestion: add an explicit data-testid='last-edited-popup' wrapper (already present at line 127 of LastEditedPopup.jsx) — already done. Good.
FE source assertion test for 'handleProceed clears ref FIRST' uses substring offsets — fragile to future refactors. Acceptable for now since it's testing a documented invariant from the prompt.

success_rate.frontend: N/A (skipped per review_request; static source assertions in backend suite cover wiring)

test_credentials: Not required — /api/audit/portal/audit-logs/* endpoints accept attribution via request body fields (user_id/username) or X-User-Id/X-Username headers. admin/admin123 not used.
seed_data_creation: Per run, creates two TEST_LEP_<8hex> clients (warehouse store + cycle_count) plus a project + day plus ~5 reco_adjust audit_log entries seeded against a shared barcode BAR_SHARED_<RUN_TAG> to exercise cross-module recent lookup. All cleaned via DELETE /clients/{id} in module-scope fixture teardown. No production-data mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for the Last Edited popup feature is /app/backend/tests/test_last_edited_popup_backend.py + /app/backend/tests/test_audit_movement_log.py. Run together: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_last_edited_popup_backend.py /app/backend/tests/test_audit_movement_log.py -v`. If a future change introduces a 'recent' endpoint cap that caps below 5, test_default_limit_is_5_or_less will still pass (it asserts ≤5). The cross-module test depends on POST /reco-adjustments accepting cycle_count style payloads (with cycle_project_id/cycle_day) OR auto-resolving module from client_type — both code paths are handled with a fallback in the fixture, so the test should remain stable.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 44 backend tests pass, FE static wiring matches the prompt 2 specification exactly (LastEditedPopup contract, useLastEditPopup callback-in-ref-cleared-first invariant, BarcodeEditCell dual-render branches, 3 PortalReports RecoInput callsites with clientId+recoBarcode, FullScreenReport RecoCell wiring).
